name: Inorganic Clusters and Frameworks
description: Synthesis, properties, and diverse applications of molecular rings, clusters, and metal-organic frameworks; the structure and function of p-block and transition metal-containing high-nuclearity inorganic clusters, including polyoxometalates, zintl ions and infinite metal chains. The structure and properties of porous zeolites, molecular polyhedra, and cages. Coordination polymers and reticular synthesis of metal-organic frameworks. Structural analysis of some selected MOFs. Emerging applications of these functional materials towards catalysis and sustainable energy conversion.
